ios.desc:
Turn your customers into your most effective marketing channel.

Rippl is a commission-based referral platform. Brands create campaigns with real cash commissions. Promoters share, track, and earn. You only pay when someone converts.

FOR BRANDS
Create a referral campaign in minutes. Set your commission rates. Generate trackable links for every promoter. Real-time dashboard showing clicks, conversions, and earnings. Pay only on results.

FOR PROMOTERS
Browse brands and campaigns you believe in. Get your unique trackable link instantly. See clicks and earnings update in real time. Withdraw commissions weekly.

WHY COMMISSIONS BEAT DISCOUNTS
Paying real money per referral outperforms discount codes by 3-4x.

WORKS FOR
Apps, physical products, services, subscriptions, and local businesses.

Free to join as a promoter. Brand plans from a low monthly rate.

NOW IN 8 LANGUAGES — Rippl is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese. Set your preferred language in Profile → Settings → App Language.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/
Privacy Policy: https://mrvltechnologies.com/privacy-policy/
